resolved: 1 critical -- agent:progress published absolute filesystem paths to the renderer; withoutFilesystemPaths in paths.ts now reduces every path in a progress line to root-relative or basename, and tests/integration/agent-progress.test.ts proves it over the real recorded transcript
2 major -- the materialised wiki survived switching agents off; agent:enable{false} now awaits view.remove(), asserted in agent-channels.test.ts by running a real pass and then switching off

3 major -- agent:accept TOCTOU minted two documents on a double accept; LibrarianService.accept shares the in-flight promise per proposal id. The test holds both writers on a gate in the real window rather than racing them, because as a plain race it reproduced only 3 times in 6

4 major -- "one pass at a time" was decided by runner.busy, which only goes true at the spawn, leaving the whole of materialise() unguarded; LibrarianService owns the flag now and both the agent:run guard and decidePass read it

5 major -- no test had the spawned child attempt an escape; fake-claude now tries to write into every --add-dir root and records the errno, and the A02 test asserts the kernel refused every one. ENOENT is deliberately not an accepted code

6 major -- A13 passed because harvest missed the recorded run's file, not because nothing was found; the pass is now genuinely quiet (WR_FAKE_CLAUDE_QUIET) and asserts no markdown the child wrote is left anywhere in the run directory

7 major -- the write/harvest seam is covered end to end: the child writes to ./proposals/ relative to its own cwd, the real ProposalReader finds it, and the recorded argv is asserted to contain the ./proposals/ instruction so both ends of the seam are production code

resolved: 1 major -- a routine zotero:import fell back to the remembered import scope, which made it a *scoped* run, which lifted every removal inside those collections. The plain Import button silently undid curation. Fixed with ScopeOrigin ('named' vs 'remembered'): only a collection named in this action lifts a removal. The old test passed only because its fixture never wrote zotero.importScope

2 major -- the restore path enqueued an index-fts job and nothing has ever drained one (the only consumer claims extract-text), so a restored document and ALL its annotations stayed unfindable forever. [B01] asserted the queued row, so 'queued' and 'never done' had the same observable. Fixed with SearchIndexer.reindexDocument + a pipeline drain for index-fts + the local-file restore path enqueuing too

3 major -- card art checked its one-host allow-list on the first hop only and passed redirect:'follow'. artUrl asks for format=image, which Scryfall answers WITH a redirect, so an unchecked hop was the normal path and the bytes came from an undisclosed host. Fixed by following redirects by hand with the allow-list on every hop (scheme and port included, bounded at 3), and naming cards.scryfall.io in the disclosure, README.md and docs/SECURITY.md

resolved: 1 major -- the retired word survived in every failure: IpcCallError prefixed the user-facing message with the channel name and nine handlers threw notFound('question'), so a missing notebook read 'question:notebook: question not found' on the page milestone 5 renamed. Fixed: the message is the main process's sentence, the channel is a field; all nine say notebook. Tests: renderer/ipc.test.ts, and an integration test driving 13 question:*/journal:* channels against a missing id

2 major -- the notebook directory never re-read while the app ran (useCallback([]) + one useEffect, no subscription, and Dockview detaches rather than unmounts). Write a day in a notebook journal, come back: the row still said "nothing yet". Fixed with api.onDidVisibilityChange + journal/library/notebook subscriptions; new E2E writes the day and reads the row in the same process

3 major -- [F02]'s ring was creation order with a random ULID tiebreak (page_index is NULL for markdown and saved pages), so the test failed ~1 run in 3 and the order was not reading order at all. Fixed with migration 013 (text_start projected from every anchor's position.start) and ORDER BY (page_index, text_start, created_at, id); new test marks five paragraphs bottom-up

4 major -- FOCUS_EDGE_LIMIT=2000 cut the edge set before ranking, so it decided which files appeared and elidedNeighbours counted only survivors: 3,000 neighbours reported as 1,984 elided, 1,000 files gone in silence. Fixed by grouping "where it leads" in SQL with no ceiling; new test seeds 2,100 neighbours and asserts 2,084

5 major -- overview called #edgesTouching (EDGES_PER_NODE=400) once per drawn node, so two hub files joined by a later link were drawn with no line between them while truncated/elidedNodes spoke only of nodes. Fixed: one query over the drawn set through an indexed temp table; new test

6 major -- GraphOverview.edges was unbounded (24,865 edges at 1,000 files / 200,600 links) while the schema documented the answer as capped. Fixed with edgeLimit on the request and totalEdges/elidedEdges on the answer, shown separately on the page; new test

7 major -- overview() read links whole with a six-branch existence check per row (1,570 ms at nodeLimit 300 on a dense corpus, synchronous main process) and reran on every library:changed including annotation. Fixed: liveness joined once against the deleted-endpoint set, each half grouped along an index (272->122 ms ranking, 2,750->230 ms whole answer), ranking counts only drawn kinds so a highlight cannot change the answer and the panel does not redraw for one. Tests: the plan of the statement the repository ran (via better-sqlite3 verbose), and an invariance + subscription test

8 major -- the crawl carried the previous file's pan and zoom onto the next file, against graph-canvas's own documented rule; every focused file is laid out at the centre, so at the extremes the new file was off the panel. Fixed with useSceneView(subject); new E2E pans, crawls, and reads data-pan-x/y and data-zoom

9 major -- a saved-page anchor fabricated its evidence: locateNearest kept the {0,len} hint when the words were not in the extracted text, so the recorded position and the prefix/suffix cut from it described the top of the page, and the fuzzy pass (hint +/- 4000) never reached a sentence further down. Fixed: locateNearest returns null, HtmlAnchor.position is optional, a quote-only anchor searches the whole page; new test over a real page with display:none markup 7.8k characters in

10 major -- the ledger listed a deleted highlight's link as live and unbroken (deleted_at was checked only at the near end), so the panel navigated to a highlight that no longer exists while graph.focus correctly dropped it. Fixed: LIVE_EDGE extracted to repositories/live-edge.ts and used by the ledger query; new test asserts both surfaces before and after

11 major -- H01 shipped with no affordance: the only way to highlight a saved page was an undocumented right-click, and every other reader raises its bar on mouseup. Fixed with a hint line in the article panel, asserted in [H01] before and after a highlight is made

12 major -- a stale selectedDocumentId paired the selected highlight with the wrong file (tab activation re-pointed the file only for pdf-reader), sending the ledger, the focused view and the link picker to the paper you were not reading. Fixed: activation runs one host rule for every reader kind and drops a highlight from the file you left; the three activation handlers and annotation navigation set both halves. New E2E
